# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 21 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Greek MS | **Section:** Aseneth Intercedes; Pharaoh's Son Dies; Pharaoh Dies

---

**1** Simeon, Levi, and their brothers wanted to kill Pharaoh's son, but Aseneth said: 'Do not render evil for evil to any man. The Lord God will avenge this wrong himself — do not kill him.'

**2** They obeyed Aseneth and left Pharaoh's son lying on the ground, half dead.

**3** Dan and Gad came and threw themselves on the ground before Aseneth and said: 'Have mercy on us, your servants. We have done evil against you and your husband Joseph and plotted wicked things against you. But now do not repay us for our wickedness, for we see that the Lord God is fighting for you.'

**4** Aseneth said to them: 'Take courage and do not be afraid. Your brother Joseph is a God-fearing man and he will not repay evil for evil to any man. Go now — do not be afraid.'

**5** They were relieved and rose from the ground, bowed before Aseneth, and went away.

**6** Three days later, Pharaoh's son died from the wound Benjamin had inflicted on him.

**7** Pharaoh heard what his son had done against Joseph and Aseneth and was deeply grieved, and he fell ill and died a few days later at the age of one hundred and nine years.

**8** Joseph took the crown of Pharaoh and placed it on his own head and reigned over Egypt for forty-eight years.

**9** After all this, Joseph and Aseneth lived in peace.

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
